name: normalizes relative and absolute paths
input: relative path with dot, dot-dot, and repeated slashes
test:
assert cd('/foo/bar', 'baz') == '/foo/bar/baz'
assert cd('/foo/bar', '../baz//./qux') == '/foo/baz/qux'
assert cd('/x/y', '/a//b/../c') == '/a/c'
assert cd('/', '../../x') == '/x'

name: normalizes dot-dot before matching symlink prefixes
input: a parent traversal cancels a link component before lookup
test:
assert cd("/a", "link/..", links={"/a/link": "/x/y"}) == "/a"
assert cd("/a", "link/../keep", links={"/a/link": "/x/y", "/a/keep": "/z"}) == "/z"
